title: Corrections reroute; they do not delete. Backcast every lineage onto one developmental path and never shrink the founder's capability horizon
statement: When a founder correction conflicts with an earlier implementation assumption, identify which axis changed (hardware, sequence, timing, provider, interface, implementation mechanism, scale, maturity, budget, authority, immediate priority, or final intended effect) and reroute: preserve the destination, recompute the current position, port validated capability, and assign future work to its developmental node. Place every material artifact on one Backcast GPS timeline with one of ten classes. Keep every founder-intended capability horizon, classified by present feasibility, at the node where it becomes buildable. Keep exactly one operationally primary node. Classify an implementation as genuinely obsolete only when its intended effect is no longer wanted, a demonstrably stronger canonical mechanism replaced it, or continuing it would violate current constraints or authority.
source: Direct founder message, second turn of Claude Code session session_01Wy6qJuxKgeiYK3xXXAE6QD, 2026-09-30
